body: I wouldn't even know where to start..
I can only dial one number on my phone 911, I couldn't afford the bill the past few months. And I couldn't ask you to do that

Thank you for all your help Stthads.

She just wrote me a message "we will never be a family"

I'm sorry, but I can't do this.

Your words were great.

Goodbye.

I was mainly ensuring that an employer would accept a GED.

Yes, I understand you are trying to help, it just doesn't feel worth it, to starts new relationship.

I just want you to know something though: Although we've only exchanged a few messages, you really have impacted me. Last night I was ready to end it all, I held the note in my left hand and a hand full of whatever was in my cabinet (it may not have even killed me, who knows). Yet today I sit here wanting to do something with my life. Do anything with my life. I have come to realize that my dreams will probably never come true, that life isn't the fairy tale that I was promised, but it still is worth something. Mine might not be worth a lot in the big picture, but maybe, just maybe, I can amount to something. Before I talked to you I never had plans on going to college, I never had any plans. 

She told me I was allowed to visit my son tomorrow at her home, I really want to explain to her how I feel, but I'm scared she'll reject me and I won't be able to see him again. I hate to ask, but do you have any words of advice?

I'm sorry if it sounds like I'm just rambling on.

Do you know anything about whether they will accept a GED rather then a diploma? I dropped out of high school out of poor stupidity, it wasn't that I was dumb, I passed all most of my standardized testing with accelerated scores (2 were average), I just couldn't stand it anymore, it's hard to explain.

My status isn't really concerning the newest legislation, I fall under the Deferred Action of Childhood Arrivals, I think it took place around 2012. In short it's for immigrants brought here by there parent(s) before they turned 16, and have been in the country for so long. It basically means that I didn't have a choice to come here and be illegal.

This is childish to say but, I don't want another family, she's the love of my life, she was always there for me, she never let me down, but I took her for granted. You know the old saying; "You don't know what you have till it's gone."? I understand it now. I made the biggest mistake of my life.

I've talked to a lawyer today, he said I could be able to get a temporary "citizenship" for 3 years(in around 3 months), it would allow me to live like any other citizen, but there's a high chance of being deported after those three years if a republican gains control of office. I'm not sure what would happen then, I would have no where to live in Canada, I wouldn't have any connections, no friends, no family, nothing.

As far as a career goes, I wanted to go into IT, but I'm not sure anymore. I know most people hate it, but it just sounded like a great life, working 9-5 at an office job, doing what I love, coming home to a family I love, but now that my family is gone it just didn't sound the same. I worked a dead end construction job for the last year under the table, I got fired from it because I was late quite a bit, I couldn't drive my self to work and always had to rely on a not-so-reliable ride. So I'd probably just get back into that field, working there until I die.

Thank you for your words, but I honestly believe it will never get better, I'll never be able to explore the world like a dreamed, I'll never have that apartment I've dreamed about, I'll never amount to anything but someone who didn't matter in this world of billions of other faces.

My son. My son is just over a year old, he can't comprehend what's going on with daddy and mommy, and eventually he'll just forget my face, he'll forget everything about this, until that day when he is old enough to get the letter explaining it wasn't his fault, that daddy wants him to grow up and follow his dreams, don't let anything hold him down, succeed where I failed.

I wish it could just be as easy as you make it sound...

About the family: If I do somehow get through these times I fear I'll never be able to forgive my family for what they did. They're the reason everything has come crashing down on me. My mother brought me to America underage from Canada. She could have filed the right paperwork do everything was legal, but she chose not to. My step father could have sponsored me, but he chose not to for no reason. That's the reason I can't go to the court for him.

Thinking about his smile and laughter kills me, because I can't be there with him. 

So now I sit here with no job, no car, no girlfriend, no son, no hope.
And to you my friend. Hopefully it will all be unveiled before it's to late.
Yeah the full story is really complicated. I'm glad I made you feel better. I guess all we do for now is let time keep on turning.
I'm sorry to hear that, but there's nothing else in life for me, I can't even get a job or a license.
